title: Find unused tag ranges
hints: Look at each pair of neighbours: zip(tags, tags[1:]) gives (tags[0], tags[1]), (tags[1], tags[2]), ...
A pair (prev, cur) hides a gap when cur - prev > 1; the missing range is (prev + 1, cur - 1). Equal neighbours are duplicates and need no special handling.
If cur < prev the list is not sorted: raise ValueError right there. The empty and single-element cases produce no pairs, so they give [] for free.
